title: Dashboard Slow Page Loads
customerImpact: Dashboard page loads took up to 8 seconds during peak. API and notification delivery unaffected.
investigation: Slow queries on the analytics aggregate endpoint.
rootCause: A new analytics aggregate query missed an index, scanning the events table per dashboard load.
mitigation: Added the missing index and warmed the cache.
monitoring: P95 dashboard load time monitored for 2 hours.
resolution: Dashboard load times normalized. No data loss.

updates.author: Tomás Rivera, SRE
updates.details: Analytics aggregate query missing an index.
